name: swarm
description: Coordinate subagents through a shared message board: names, roster, messages, judges and verifiers. Hooks act on tool calls only inside an active swarm job (trust them in /hooks); a first session sets up a venv, a launcher, config and Codex sandbox roots, and on Linux a background supervisor timer. See README: What Swarm changes on your machine.

interface.longDescription: Swarm lets a lead agent and its subagents coordinate through a shared message board: unique names, a roster, messages delivered before tool calls, verifiers, judges that decide whether a goal is met, project memory and a transcript archive. It needs its lifecycle hooks (trust them in /hooks); see the README for what it changes on your machine.
